meta.primary_metric: paired clean->perturbed degradation (referral-flip, ΔAUC, Δsens@spec, retention)
meta.note: the B-scan APPEARANCE/QUALITY-TOLERANCE stress axis (ImageNet-C/MedMNIST-C bar), NOT the calibrated device axis (that is the map/thickness panel). FMs are all OOD on disc (no disc-native FM has public weights) → compared on equal all-OOD footing; the supervised B-scan CNN is the IN-DOMAIN from-scratch arm (scored on its OWN held-out GLEAM split — comparable in KIND, not on the FMs' exact eyes). GLEAM is single-center (~40-180 glaucoma) → the retention gate can be 'indeterminate' (disclosed). Axis-LABELLED bscan; NEVER cross-ranked against the map/device panel (§0).
